description: Implementation of MessageUnit class handling message serialization, updating, and dispatching within the Thunder messaging framework.

classes.name: MessageUnit
classes.description: Singleton class managing message serialization, control updates, and message dispatching in the Thunder framework.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Nested classes within methods for handling control iteration and message processing.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes control data into a buffer, either for a specific module or all modules.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates control states based on provided metadata and settings.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of MessageUnit.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes MessageUnit with configuration, creates dispatcher, and sets up environment.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes redirects, and destroys controls.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Determines if a control is enabled by default based on settings.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a message and its info to the buffer or directly outputs it.
